objective.primaryRule: No primary and no roles are selected for any use (diagnostic; adaptation AD1). The unchanged NL0 original rule (P0) and RA1 (P1) are re-applied to Assignment 3's archived populations as controls; the experimental selectors P2 (capital-and-stop-aware, MDD-hard) and P2b (alternative constraint) are frozen in PROTOCOL.md §9 before any P2 result and compared retrospectively; nothing is nominated, adopted or deployed.

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity)

budget.notes: No search proposals (diagnostic). backendEvaluations caps all fresh simulations: bounded deterministic replays of fixed, already-sealed configurations (PROTOCOL.md §10: S0+S3 candidates <= 160, S3 regenerated selection families <= 3,100, S4 DD-infeasible centres <= 120, S5 member, fold, item-9 and C24 rows <= 2,800). Record and search-archive reads are counted apart and are not simulations.

deviations.description: no primary or role is selected for any use; selectors are compared retrospectively on archived populations
deviations.justification: brief Stage 5 and success criterion: do not optimize new phenotypes, promote N/original or replace New L0

deviations.description: the experimental selectors P2/P2b use trade principal loss, banked-capital drawdown, the stop-aware conservative value of the open lot and a bounded-loss-exit tier as gates and ranking inputs (study-scoped; P0, P1, Q1-Q6 and the standard unchanged)
deviations.justification: the brief's Stage 5 asks for exactly such a capital-and-stop-aware selector to be designed and compared
deviations.userAgreement: brief/BRIEF.md Stage 5: 'Prepare explicit, versioned experimental alternatives ... P2 / capital-and-stop-aware: a proposed selector that distinguishes losses below trade principal from profitable-trade giveback, accounts for actual stop state and exposure, and preserves portfolio MDD/margin headroom as material risks.'

deviations.description: FULL (previously examined) is opened only to replay fixed configurations already sealed by completed studies with sealed FULL guards, and for descriptive C24 rows of the frozen P2 primaries; no choice uses it
deviations.justification: brief Stage 0 and Stage 3 require full-history parity and metrics of the sealed candidates

deviations.description: no search and no new vector; bounded deterministic replays of sealed configurations and of sealed neighbourhood families regenerated with the audited study's code and seeds (cap 6,200)
deviations.justification: brief: 'NOT another multimillion-evaluation optimization'; Stage 3 and Stage 5.8 allow the narrowest read-only replays

deviations.description: no tuning benchmark; in-process replays in one contained systemd unit at a time; observed memory reported
deviations.justification: standard §6.3: diagnostics report observed use instead of benchmarking

deviations.description: P2/P2b fold paths are retrospective (designed after the slices and P0/P1 outcomes were examined); reported with Assignment 3's frozen labels but never as independent chronological evidence
